The '''Trellen system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the planet [[Trellen]]. It was located at the junction of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />
